item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 18/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense winter monsoon will bring cold weather to Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be windy over the region, and the weather will be fine and very dry. Temperatures over the coast of southern China is expected to rise slightly midweek this week. However, under the influence of a replenishment of the monsoon, it will still be rather cool in the morning and at night over the region.

Date/Month: 18/12 (Sunday)
Wind: North force 5 to 6, occasionally up to force 8 on high ground and offshore at first.
Weather: Cold. Mainly fine and very dry.
Temp range: 8 - 13 C
R.H. range: 20 - 40 per Cent
PSR: Low
